svg.title: Placement and simulation
svg.desc: A four-question instrument selects the smallest state model that can answer the job.

text.tspan: Ask what must be true, then pay only for that

g.title: Known comparator strength needs no world
g.desc: signal(0..15) writes the shorthand state directly when only the encoded level matters.

g.title: Neighbour-derived state needs placement context
g.desc: Simulated placement resolves stairs, fences, rails, and other states that depend on nearby blocks.

g.title: Circuit truth belongs to MCHPRS
g.desc: Use the circuit engine when the question is redstone output rather than general world evolution.

g.title: World evolution needs ticks
g.desc: TickSimulation handles scheduled updates, fluids, entities, pistons, and temporal causality.

text.tspan: Choose the smallest engine that answers the question
Direct shorthand, placement context, circuit execution, and world ticks solve different classes of state.
